item.title: Pavement blocked by commercial shelving units, 18th August
item.description:

This is significantly reducing the amount of space for people to move through especially those with mobility difficulties. Please investigate what planning permission was issued for this to be installed.

item.title: There is a Mandatory Left-Turn Sign, that is faded and has seen better times. No motorist takes any notice of the Mandatory Left-Turn onto the A23 North Carriageway., 18th August
item.description:
Motorist are going straight across the A23 to access Downton Avenue on Streatham Hill Eastside. Equally, motorist cross the A23, to turn right onto the A23 going south. The Mandatory Left-Turn Sign either needs to be taken down, or replaced with a brand new shiny version. The current A23 Streatham Hill Barrhill Road Plans, show Barrhill Road One-way Left Out. It's not happening and with the unveiling of the Streatham Hill Remodelling, there will be plenty of accidents.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Barrhill Road, Streatham Hill, Greater London
